description: Count a Bulgarian legal deadline the way the Civil Procedure Code does (ГПК чл. 60): days count from the day after the event; weeks, months and years end on the corresponding date; an end on a non-working day moves to the next working day. Returns the last day and each step with its reason. Other laws can have their own rules: tell the user to check the letter or the law.

from.description: The day of the event the deadline runs from, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. the day a letter was received).

name: srok_deadline

citations.description: Every source the result rests on. Cite url; give checkedOn or publishedOn.

countedEnd.description: Where the count lands before the non-working-day rule.

end.description: The last day to act, YYYY-MM-DD.
